name: Strength of the Dead

text.fail: The colony loses all its barricades, then ten zombies pour in. No morale is lost.
text.bonus: Two cards beyond the need lift morale by 1.

notes: Name and effect read from an English card photo (bing, meoplesmagazine): Fuel, remove all colony barricades, add 10 zombies at the colony. Earlier fan record matched. Barricades removed before the zombies are added.
